entities.summary: Volodymyr Mazyar is a Ukrainian football manager and a former player. From 2021 to July 2022, he was the manager of Akzhayik in Kazakhstan. Since January 2025 he has been the manager of amateur football club Sich Dobriany in Lviv Oblast 3rd League.
